gold: Community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (CA-MRSA) sepsis with septic vasculopathy

selector.rationale: Purpura Fulminans best explains the decisive findings of purpuric retiform patches, necrotizing pneumonia, renal abscesses, and septic emboli without contradiction, supported by strong evidence from AX_SE001, AX_SE005, AX_ME007, AX_ME010, and AX_ME008.

rejected.label: Neisseria meningitidis infection
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and presence of Gram-positive cocci in vessels

rejected.label: Neisseria meningitidis sepsis
rejected.why: Similar to Neisseria meningitidis infection, lack of strong evidence and presence of Gram-positive cocci in vessels

rejected.label: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC)
rejected.why: While DIC is a possible complication, Purpura Fulminans better explains the overall clinical presentation
